explanation: This component is active only at the GO step and is 0 at every D1 and D2 step. At GO it tracks a recent run of losses: it is 10 on trial 0 and climbs about 2-4 per unrewarded trial in a row, reaching 8-10 after 3 or more losses; after a rewarded trial it falls to about half of its last value (giving 4, then 3, 2, 1 if rewards continue) and is 0 during long rewarded streaks, and it runs weaker late in the episode (after about trial 70 a single loss gives only 0-3).
